name: Aoki Shinjuku
source:
Shinjuku, 2017. Sharp rise in temperature resulted in flood of huge territories. 
Deck runs an "information store" and gets a request to investigate a "NOKIA" program. At the same time a big package is delivered that turns out to be a girl who awakens from Cold Sleep and remembers only Shinjuku of 20th century prior to the huge flood...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2017年的新宿。气温急剧上升，导致大片地区被洪水淹没。

Deck经营着一家“信息商店”，接到调查“NOKIA”程序的委托。与此同时，一个巨大的包裹被送到店里。包裹里竟是一名刚从冷冻睡眠中醒来的女孩，而她只记得大洪水发生前、20世纪的新宿……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
